coalition.description:
Escort CSA Cargo Ship LAAT/c (JLC-594) as they complete their duties.

We will assign targets to you when your targeting computer is free. Engagements against factions that are outside the scope of our mission will be ignored.

To complete the mission, ensure that CSA Cargo Ship LAAT/c (JLC-594) completes all their trade orders. New trade orders that they receive during the mission may extend the mission duration. The mission will end early when CSA Cargo Ship LAAT/c (JLC-594) is left with no escort for more than 5 minutes.

You will be rewarded for each trade they complete, adjusted by the sectors they traversed, the amount of time that your ships were in escort (while within 100km), and for enemies that your ships engage.

Failure condition is: when CSA Cargo Ship LAAT/c (JLC-594) fail to complete any trade.

Current trade mission: Buy Food Rations from Dellalt.

(Note that CSA Cargo Ship LAAT/c (JLC-594) can travel up to 7319 m/s.)

coalition.description: I need a fast ship and a good pilot to get me away from this station as quickly as possible. Doesn't really matter where I end up, as long as no one finds me before I get there! Can I count on your help? If so, land at the station and meet me on the dock area. I'll wait for you there. Will you help me?
coalition.name: Fast Flight

coalition.description: We don't know whether it was one of our competitors or pirates, but someone has detonated a number of EMPs across our properties and we are hiring people to help us fix the leaks they've caused. We're spreading out the work so that no one person must fix all leaks. If you accept the job, we'll assign you to: 1x properties.
coalition.name: Leak Fix Contract

coalition.description:
This is a general call for anyone looking for excitement and adventure, and the opportunity to serve as part of a great military body. We are looking for fit and healthy marines that are willing to help us in any of our boarding operations. Each should be trained as described below and brought or make their way to the following location.
Seeking: 1x Marine(s)
Delivery location: CSA Spice Farm I (SZT-041)
We are looking for experienced people. Required skills:
Boarding: [menu_star_04][menu_star_04][menu_star_01][menu_star_01][menu_star_01]
Morale: [menu_star_04][menu_star_01][menu_star_01][menu_star_01][menu_star_01]
coalition.name: Marines Needed

coalition.description:
With so much conflict around the Jump Gate network, we feel it is only a matter of time before this area of space sees major conflict, and would like to be prepared for this scenario. We request that a defensive platform station be built in the sector specified to help us deter threats from our space. The facility must fit the following specifications.

Destination: Dellalt (at specified location)
Minimum plot size: 5 x 6 x 5 km
Required constructs: 3 x Defence Modules, 1 x Dock Area, 1 x Pier, 1 x Wide Area Sensor Array, 16 x Turrets, 6 x Shield Generators

Estimated minimum build cost: 9,009,000 Cr

To be a valid Defence Station, one of the Defence Modules must be an Administrative Centre.

Expenses will be covered generously, within reason.
coalition.name: Pre-emptive Defences

coalition.description: Once again, our main competitor has proved what low depths they'll reach to in order to gain an advantage, placing explosive mines around one of our supplier station in order to push us out of the market. We're looking for someone who can safely and swiftly dismantle the mines on our behalf.
coalition.name: Steady Trigger Finger Required

coalition.description:
Support CSA Star Destroyer Venator (PHE-738) on their patrol of Boonta for at least 20 minutes.

Your priority is to patrol the sector - whether with the mission guidance or on your own.

We will assign targets to you when your targeting computer is free. These are optional targets and you are allowed to ignore them or engage other targets on your own. However, except for attacks against criminals, engagements against factions that we have not targeted will be ignored.

The mission completes when CSA Star Destroyer Venator (PHE-738) completes their orders or when no enemy targets are found after 20 minutes. New combat orders that they receive during the mission may extend the mission. Escort and kill rewards continue to accumulate past 20 minutes. You can request an early release from the mission.

You will be rewarded for enemies that your ships engage plus a bonus if CSA Star Destroyer Venator (PHE-738) survives.

The mission will end early if you have no ships in the mission sector for more than 5 minutes.

(Note that CSA Star Destroyer Venator (PHE-738) can travel up to 10511 m/s.)
coalition.name: Support Corporate Sector Authority patrol: Boonta
